nodes.title: SOP-BS-09 Batch Safety Verification Protocol
nodes.summary: To verify batch safety, confirm the lot status is not HOLD or QUARANTINE.
facts: To verify batch safety, confirm the lot status is not HOLD or QUARANTINE.
Review the Certificate of Analysis and confirm expiry is more than 30 days away.
The triage status is GREEN when all batch safety checks pass.
The triage status is AMBER when one minor flag exists and an operator must review within 8 hours.
The triage status is RED when the lot is on hold and QA must be notified immediately.

nodes.title: SOP-CH-10 Change Control
nodes.summary: A change request requires 3 signatures before implementation.
facts: A change request requires 3 signatures before implementation.
A change effectiveness check must be performed after 90 days.

nodes.title: SOP-CC-01 Cold-Chain Storage and Excursion Handling
nodes.summary: Cold-chain products must be stored at 2-8°C at all times.
facts: Cold-chain products must be stored at 2-8°C at all times.
A temperature excursion above 8°C lasting more than 4 hours requires the lot to be quarantined.
Any reading above 12°C at any duration requires immediate quarantine of the lot.
Temperature data loggers must record at an interval of 5 minutes.
A temperature excursion report must be filed within 24 hours of detection.

nodes.title: SOP-DV-07 Deviation Management
nodes.summary: A minor deviation must be closed within 30 days.
facts: A minor deviation must be closed within 30 days.
A major deviation requires an investigation to open within 5 days and close within 45 days.
A critical deviation requires notifying the QA director within 24 hours and closing within 60 days.
Every deviation must be linked to a CAPA.

nodes.title: SOP-HZ-04 Hazardous Materials Storage
nodes.summary: A flammable cabinet may hold at most 60 L of flammable liquids.
facts: A flammable cabinet may hold at most 60 L of flammable liquids.
Corrosives must be segregated from flammables by at least 1 meter or stored in separate cabinets.
Spill response must begin within 15 minutes of detection.
An eyewash station must be reachable within 10 seconds of any hazmat storage area.
Hazmat handling training must be renewed every 12 months.

nodes.title: SOP-LR-06 Lot Release
nodes.summary: Lot release requires QA approval with 2 signatures.
facts: Lot release requires QA approval with 2 signatures.
The Certificate of Analysis must be reviewed within 3 business days.
Any hold or quarantine on the lot must be cleared before release.
A released lot receives the status RELEASED in the inventory system.

nodes.title: SOP-QA-02 Quarantine Procedure
nodes.summary: A quarantined lot must be tagged within 30 minutes of the decision.
facts: A quarantined lot must be tagged within 30 minutes of the decision.
The quarantined lot must be moved to quarantine zone Q-1.
QA must be notified within 2 hours of quarantine.
The disposition decision must be made within 10 business days.
A quarantined lot may never be shipped or used in production.

nodes.title: SOP-RK-08 Product Recall
nodes.summary: A Class I recall must be notified to the regulator within 4 hours.
facts: A Class I recall must be notified to the regulator within 4 hours.
A Class II recall must be notified within 24 hours.
A recall effectiveness check must be completed at 30 days.

nodes.title: SOP-RC-03 Receiving Inspection
nodes.summary: Incoming goods must be inspected within 24 hours of receipt.
facts: Incoming goods must be inspected within 24 hours of receipt.
Inspect a sample of 10% of cartons with a minimum of 3 cartons.
The Certificate of Analysis must match the purchase order before acceptance.
Goods with a broken seal must be rejected and reported as a deviation.

nodes.title: SOP-SA-05 Supplier Audit Program
nodes.summary: Tier A suppliers must be audited every 24 months.
facts: Tier A suppliers must be audited every 24 months.
Tier B suppliers must be audited every 12 months.
Tier C suppliers must be audited every 6 months.
The supplier audit report must be issued within 30 days of the audit.
